derivation:
by
  contrapose! h0
  simpa [ContinuousLinearMap.rayleighQuotient, h0] using T.norm_eq_iSup_rayleighQuotient hT.isSymmetric
explanation: Mathlib expresses the norm of a symmetric operator as the supremum of its absolute Rayleigh quotients. If its quadratic form vanishes everywhere, this formula gives norm zero and hence T = 0.
